answer.text:
When selecting a tri-mode wireless gaming mouse (2.4GHz + Bluetooth + Wired USB-C) with a high polling rate (4K Hz to 8K Hz) in India, performance comes down to sensor efficiency and weight. Standard wireless mice run at 1000Hz (1ms response time), whereas high-polling mice push response times down to 0.125ms–0.25ms, making tracking visibly smoother on 240Hz+ high-refresh-rate monitors.

The top options currently available in India through direct distribution or import retailers:

| Mouse Model | Max Polling Rate | Weight | Sensor | Approx. Price (INR) | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AULA SC800** | 8000Hz (2.4G) | 37g | PAW3955 / PAW3395 | ₹3,500 – ₹4,500 | Extreme ultra-lightweight performance on a budget. |
| **Attack Shark R5 Ultra / R6** | 8000Hz (2.4G) | ~39g - 49g | PAW3950MAX | ₹4,000 – ₹5,500 | Premium carbon-fiber composite feel & flagship tracking. |
| **MCHOSE K7 Ultra** | 8000Hz (2.4G & Wired) | 59g | PAW3950 | ₹5,500 – ₹7,000 | Feature-packed with an included magnetic charging dock. |
| **Keychron M2 4K / M3 Mini 4K** | 4000Hz (2.4G) | 53g - 55g | PAW3395 | ₹5,999 – ₹6,999 | Minimalist build, clean software, and solid ergonomics. |
| **Rapoo VT7 Pro** | 8000Hz (2.4G) | 53g | PAW3395 | ₹4,500 – ₹6,000 | Battery life champion with Nordic MCU efficiency. |

---

### Important Considerations for High-Polling Wireless

* **Dongle Requirements:** Most high-polling mice default to 1000Hz out of the box using their standard USB nano-dongle. Pushing the mouse to **4,000Hz or 8,000Hz requires a high-speed 4K/8K wireless dongle** (often bundled with "Ultra" or "8K" variants, but occasionally sold separately depending on the brand).
* **CPU Load:** Running at 4K/8K Hz generates thousands of input signals every second. This puts noticeable strain on your CPU; ensure you have a modern mid-to-high-end processor (e.g., Ryzen 5000/Intel 12th gen or higher) to prevent frame drops in games like *Valorant* or *CS2*.
* **Bluetooth Polling:** Tri-mode mice only achieve high polling rates (4K/8K Hz) over **2.4GHz wireless** or **wired mode**. Bluetooth mode is locked to standard 125Hz to save power for office/productivity tasks.
